The '''Yag'Dhul theater''' was one of the six theaters of operations of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], which took place during the final stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Astrography==
The Yag'Dhul theater was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]].<ref name="TEA" /> This field of operations was named after the key [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]], which was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==History==
In the Yag'Dhul theater of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Nineteenth Army]] was charged with defending the outer Trade Spine.<ref name="TEGtW" />

As the Separatists advanced from [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] to [[Bomis Koori IV]] along the Corellian Trade Spine,<ref name="TEGtW" /> battles were fought on [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|Sarrish]], [[Battle of Tar Morden|Tar Morden]] and [[Battle of Bomis Koori IV|Bomis Koori IV]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Nineteenth Army fought a number of battles and eventually managed to retain control of [[Kriselist/Legends|Kriselist]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> which sat at the [[Kriselist junction|junction]] between the Corellian Trade Spine and the [[D'Aelgoth Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Yag'Dhul theater was abruptly abandoned by the Separatists to supply [[Warship/Legends|warships]] for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] daring strike at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> Using secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] that cut through the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], the Separatist [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] slipped past Coruscant's defense net and entered [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. A [[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|battle]] ensued, culminating with General Grievous kidnapping [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="TEA" />
